player_intent: A browser player joins one 32-player WebRTC tournament, becomes one of 16 duos, and plays only the assigned 2v2 arena while winners advance through the shared bracket.
acceptance_rule: Automatic WebRTC signaling admits at most 32 peers to each tournament room, initializes peer 1 as the sole gameplay authority, and enters the canonical tournament runtime. That runtime starts 16 duos across eight isolated arena maps, derives local starts from authored markers, scopes state and damage to each arena, and uses the map-owned stair collider without changing CharacterBody3D movement.

nodes.role: Enters automatic 32-player WebRTC tournament matchmaking without a private host or room code.
Connects each browser client to peer 1 so the existing MultiplayerAPI authority and RPC contracts remain canonical.
Keeps arena zero on the canonical map root and constructs seven collision-identical isolated map instances at coordinator-owned offsets.
Provides one continuous collision surface beneath the unchanged authored stair treads for the sole CharacterBody3D movement owner.

must_not_change: CharacterBody3D movement, velocity, and collision authority
SOCOM camera and reticle aim authority
peer-1 shot, damage, ammunition, and ballistics authority
shared random round weapon and unchanged throwables
weapon hand contacts, square-shoulder fire pose, fire recovery, and reload presentation
visual_check: Open the browser build from multiple profiles, click JOIN 32-PLAYER TOURNAMENT, confirm automatic TOUR room assignment and a 16-duo lobby, then verify each player sees only the assigned 2v2 arena and can traverse its stairs while combat and animation remain unchanged.

system_delta.reason: Replace the four-player private WebRTC room-code flow with automatic 32-player tournament rooms while preserving the existing peer-1 authority, bracket, arena-isolation, map, movement, and combat owners.

current.system: Private four-peer WebRTC rooms outside the tournament product

candidate.system: Automatic 32-peer WebRTC server-relay room feeding the canonical eight-arena tournament runtime
